whatsapp.message: Hi, I'd like to talk about a project with VOSTEX.

seo.title: VOSTEX — Engineered systems for real-world operations
seo.description: Software engineering studio in Valdivia, Chile. We design and build custom software, platforms and automations so your business runs with clarity, speed and control.
seo.ogAlt: VOSTEX — Engineered systems for real-world operations

hero.headline: Engineered systems for real-world operations.
hero.subheadline: We design and build custom software, platforms and automations so your business runs with clarity, speed and control.

problem.label: The Problem
problem.title: Your operation has outgrown its tools.
problem.bridge: Generic software forces you to work its way. We build systems that work yours.

spreadsheets.title: Spreadsheets running critical processes
spreadsheets.description: Orders, inventory and clients tracked by hand, in files that only one person fully understands.

visibility.title: No real-time visibility
visibility.description: You find out about problems when they're already expensive — not when the data first showed them.

keypeople.title: Everything depends on key people
keypeople.description: Processes live in someone's head. When that person is out, the operation slows down.

services.label: Capabilities
services.title: The software backbone for operations and growth.
services.subtitle: From internal systems and portals to automation and decision tools — engineered to last and to grow.

build.name: Vostex Build
build.description: Internal systems, backends and portals designed around how your business actually works — operational tools and client-facing platforms, engineered to last and to grow.

intel.name: Vostex Intel
intel.description: We turn operational data into clear decisions: dashboards, alerts and internal assistants. When AI makes a difference we use it — always inside robust systems.

flow.name: Vostex Flow
flow.description: We automate repetitive work and connect the tools you already use. Workflows, integrations and bots that keep your processes moving.

launch.name: Vostex Launch
launch.description: Websites, portals and digital experiences on top of your systems. Clear, fast and trustworthy interfaces for customers and teams.

process.label: How We Work
process.title: A clear process, from day one.
process.subtitle: No black boxes. You know what we're building, why, and how it's going — at every step.

diagnose.title: Diagnose & map
diagnose.description: We map how your operation actually runs: processes, tools, bottlenecks and data.

design.title: Design the system
design.description: An architecture and roadmap in plain language, with priorities and scope you can challenge.

build.title: Build in iterations
build.description: Working software in short cycles. You see progress in your real operation, not slide decks.

launch.title: Launch & stay
launch.description: We train your team, monitor adoption and stay after launch. Systems evolve — so does our support.

portfolio.label: Selected Work
portfolio.title: Systems we've shipped.
portfolio.subtitle: Businesses that moved from spreadsheets and scattered tools to software they actually own.

khronos.context: A gym that needed a professional online presence to attract new members.
khronos.built: A custom landing page with its own brand identity, designed to convert visits into inquiries.
khronos.outcome: A clear, direct digital presence that reflects the brand's energy.

mishi.context: Our own 3D printing company in Valdivia: merchandising, keychains and engineering parts, both ready to ship and made to order.
mishi.built: A custom web store with a catalog, cart, quote requests for custom parts and Mercado Pago checkout.
mishi.outcome: A clear store that combines ready-to-ship products with made-to-order printing, with free delivery in Valdivia.

about.label: Philosophy
about.title: The partner your business deserves.
about.description: A software engineering studio born from a simple belief: every business deserves technology that actually works for them. We're not just a vendor — we're the expert mentor that walks alongside your transformation.
about.founder: Founded by Hernán Provoste · Valdivia, Chile.

response.title: Answers within 24 hours
response.description: Every message gets a real response from an engineer, not an autoresponder.

support.title: Support after launch
support.description: We don't disappear at go-live. Training, monitoring and evolution are part of the job.

ownership.title: You own everything
ownership.description: Code, data and infrastructure are yours. No lock-in, no hostage systems.

clarity.title: Plain language
clarity.description: We explain technical decisions clearly, so you can actually make them with us.

contact.label: Get in Touch
contact.title: Let's build something.
contact.subtitle: Tell us how your operation works today and where you want it to be. We'll map your systems and suggest a first step — no obligation.

form.message_placeholder: Tell us about your project, processes and goals.
